protocol_type: Host-mastered byte-cycle protocol over an 8-bit DQ bus. Each bus cycle is one of {Command cycle (CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n pulse latches DQ=opcode), Address cycle (CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n pulse latches DQ=address byte), Write Data cycle (CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n pulse latches DQ=write byte), Read Data cycle (CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n pulse causes device to drive DQ=read byte)}. Commands are 1-byte opcodes; many commands consist of an opcode + address cycles + (optional) data + a confirm opcode.

fields.name: Opcode
fields.value: 00h..FFh per Table 94 of ONFI 4.1; vendor-specific opcodes outside the standard set are reserved by the vendor; future-ONFI reserves 0Bh, 12h, 14h, 1Bh-1Ch, 82h-83h, 86h, 8Eh.

fields.name: Second cycle opcode
fields.value: Optional; e.g., 30h confirms Read, D0h confirms Erase, 10h confirms Page Program, 11h continues Multi-plane Program, D1h continues Multi-plane Erase, E0h confirms Change Read Column, 15h confirms Page Cache Program.

cmd_format.address_cycles: Up to 5 cycles (2 column + 3 row); column-address LSB shall be zero for NV-DDR, NV-DDR2, NV-DDR3 (data interfaces are 8n-aligned).
cmd_format.latching_edge_sdr: Rising edge of WE_n latches commands, addresses, and write data on DQ.
cmd_format.latching_edge_nv_ddr: Rising edge of CLK latches commands and addresses; both edges of DQS latch write data.
cmd_format.latching_edge_nv_ddr2_3: Rising edge of WE_n latches commands and addresses; both edges of DQS latch write data.

response_classes.name: Status byte
response_classes.content: WP_n / RDY / ARDY / VSP / CSP / R / FAILC / FAIL — returned by Read Status (70h) and Read Status Enhanced (78h).

response_classes.name: ID bytes
response_classes.content: Read ID (90h) with address 00h returns at least 4 bytes (manufacturer ID + device ID + 2 device-specific); with address 20h returns 'ONFI' signature (4Fh 4Eh 46h 49h) on ONFI-compliant devices; with address 40h returns 'JEDEC' signature.

response_classes.name: Parameter Page
response_classes.content: 256-byte Parameter Page (bytes 0-255); repeated as redundant copies at bytes 256-511 and 512-767; Read Parameter Page (ECh + 00h).

response_classes.name: Extended Parameter Page
response_classes.content: Signature 'EPPS' at bytes 2-5; contains additional section-typed records (e.g., Extended ECC Information).

response_classes.name: Unique ID
response_classes.content: 16-byte UID + 16-byte complement, repeated 16 times for 512-byte read (Read Unique ID EDh).

response_classes.name: Feature data
response_classes.content: Get Features (EEh) returns 4 bytes (P1..P4) per the feature definition (Section 5.30).

response_classes.name: Page data
response_classes.content: Read (00h/30h), Read Cache (00h/31h, 31h, 3Fh) — burst of page-size bytes on DQ.

data_block_format.page_data_burst: Bytes streamed on DQ at host RE_n pulses (SDR) or at host RE_n_t/RE_n_c with device DQS edges (NV-DDR family). Total bytes = bytes_per_page (announced in Parameter Page byte 80-83) + (optional) spare bytes; Read Cache End (3Fh) terminates pipelined sequential read.
data_block_format.write_data_burst: Host streams bytes on DQ during write-data cycles (CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n rising or DQS edges); device buffers in page register; final 10h (Page Program) or 15h (Page Cache Program) confirm triggers program.
data_block_format.tCCS_constraint: After the second address byte of a Change-Read-Column or Change-Write-Column command, the host shall wait tCCS before the next read or write data cycle.
data_block_format.data_burst_pause: Host may stop RE_n (read) or DQS (NV-DDR write) to pause a data burst; ODT (if enabled) stays enabled during pause; warmup cycles are not re-issued on resume.
data_block_format.data_burst_exit: Host raises CE_n, ALE, or CLE to one to exit the data burst; ODT (if enabled) is disabled.

command_categories.opcodes: Read ID (90h), Read Parameter Page (ECh), Read Unique ID (EDh)
Read (00h/30h), Read Cache Random (00h/31h), Read Cache Sequential (31h), Read Cache End (3Fh), Copyback Read (00h/35h), Change Read Column (05h/E0h), Change Read Column Enhanced (06h/E0h)
Page Program (80h/10h), Page Cache Program (80h/15h), Copyback Program (85h/10h), Small Data Move (85h/11h or 85h/10h), Change Write Column (85h), Change Row Address (85h)
Multi-plane Read (00h/32h), Multi-plane Page Program (80h/11h), Multi-plane Block Erase (60h/D1h)
Set Features (EFh), Get Features (EEh), LUN Set Features (D5h), LUN Get Features (D4h)
ZQ Calibration Long (F9h), ZQ Calibration Short (D9h)
Implicit DCC Training (18h), Read DQ Training (62h), Write TX DQ Training Pattern (63h), Write TX DQ Training Readback (64h), Write RX DQ Training (76h)

key_commands.name: Read
key_commands.description: Reads a page identified by row address into the page register; column address selects start of burst.

key_commands.name: Read Cache Random
key_commands.description: Pipelined random read; next-page address loaded while current page is read out.

key_commands.name: Read Cache Sequential
key_commands.description: Pipelined sequential read of next page after Read Cache Random.

key_commands.name: Read Cache End
key_commands.description: Terminates Read Cache sequence and outputs the last buffered page.

key_commands.name: Copyback Read
key_commands.description: Reads source page into page register for on-die Copyback Program (85h/10h).

key_commands.name: Change Read Column
key_commands.description: Re-points the read burst to a new column within the page register; tCCS applies.

key_commands.name: Change Read Column Enhanced
key_commands.description: Change Read Column with full 5-cycle address for multi-LUN page-register reposition.

key_commands.name: Block Erase
key_commands.description: Erases the block addressed by the 3 row-address cycles. Status bit 0 (FAIL) on completion.

key_commands.name: Multi-plane Block Erase
key_commands.description: Erases blocks across multiple planes within a LUN concurrently.

key_commands.name: Read Status
key_commands.description: Returns the composite per-LUN status register byte.

key_commands.name: Read Status Enhanced
key_commands.description: Returns the status for the LUN and plane addressed by the 3 row-address cycles; turns off other LUN output buffers.

key_commands.name: Page Program
key_commands.description: Programs a page from the page register at the row/column address. Host streams write data between 80h+address and 10h.

key_commands.name: Multi-plane Page Program
key_commands.description: Programs pages across planes concurrently. 11h commits to next plane; final 10h commits all.

key_commands.name: Page Cache Program
key_commands.description: Pipelined program — host may issue next 80h while previous page is still programming.

key_commands.name: Copyback Program / Small Data Move
key_commands.description: Programs the destination page from the page register previously loaded via Copyback Read; Small Data Move optionally overwrites specific bytes.

key_commands.name: Multi-plane Copyback Program
key_commands.description: Copyback Program across multiple planes.

key_commands.name: Change Write Column
key_commands.description: Re-points the write burst to a new column within the page register; tCCS applies.

key_commands.name: Change Row Address
key_commands.description: Changes the row address for the write data already in the page register.

key_commands.name: Read ID
key_commands.description: Address 00h returns Mfr/Device ID; address 20h returns 'ONFI' signature; address 40h returns 'JEDEC' signature.

key_commands.name: Volume Select
key_commands.description: Selects the volume address (Section 3.2) to direct subsequent CE_n-shared commands.

key_commands.name: ODT Configure
key_commands.description: Configures matrix-termination ODT for the target.

key_commands.name: ZQ Calibration Short
key_commands.description: Periodic short ZQ calibration; updates output driver impedance for V/T drift.

key_commands.name: ZQ Calibration Long
key_commands.description: Long ZQ calibration after reset; tZQCL ≥ 1 µs.

key_commands.name: Read Parameter Page
key_commands.description: Address 00h reads Parameter Page + redundant copies + optional Extended Parameter Page.

key_commands.name: Read Unique ID
key_commands.description: Address 00h returns UID + complement repeated 16 times for retrieval-error detection.

key_commands.name: Get Features
key_commands.description: Address selects the feature (e.g., FAh=Timing Mode, 02h=NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 Configuration, 10h=I/O Drive Strength).

key_commands.name: Set Features
key_commands.description: Sets the addressed feature with 4 parameter bytes P1..P4 supplied as write data.

key_commands.name: Reset LUN
key_commands.description: Resets only the LUN addressed; other LUNs continue.

key_commands.name: Synchronous Reset
key_commands.description: Resets the target without changing the active data interface or timing mode.

key_commands.name: Reset
key_commands.description: Resets the target; returns to SDR data interface, timing mode 0.

key_commands.name: Implicit DCC Training (NV-DDR3)
key_commands.description: Implicit duty-cycle correction training; NV-DDR3 only.

key_commands.name: Read DQ Training (NV-DDR3)
key_commands.description: Outputs the read training pattern for host-side DQ centering.

key_commands.name: Write TX DQ Training Pattern (NV-DDR3)
key_commands.description: Host writes a training pattern to the device for later readback comparison.

key_commands.name: Write TX DQ Training Readback (NV-DDR3)
key_commands.description: Device returns the previously written training pattern for host-side TX adjust.

key_commands.name: Write RX DQ Training (NV-DDR3)
key_commands.description: Device performs RX-side DQ training using host-driven pattern.

channels.name: CE_n
channels.description: Chip Enable (active-low). When LOW, target is selected; when HIGH the target enters low-power standby (if ready).

channels.name: CLE
channels.description: Command Latch Enable. When HIGH during WE_n rising edge, DQ is latched as a command opcode.

channels.name: ALE
channels.description: Address Latch Enable. When HIGH during WE_n rising edge, DQ is latched as an address byte.

channels.name: WE_n
channels.description: Write Enable (SDR). Rising edge latches commands, addresses, and write data. Shares pin with CLK on NV-DDR.

channels.name: CLK
channels.description: Clock for NV-DDR data interface. Shares pin with WE_n; for NV-DDR2/NV-DDR3 the WE_n pin retains its WE_n role for cmd/addr latching.

channels.name: RE_n / RE_t
channels.description: Read Enable (True). Falling edge causes device to output next read byte on DQ in SDR; in NV-DDR family RE_n shares pin with W/R_n.

channels.name: W/R_n
channels.description: Write/Read Direction (NV-DDR). Selects owner of DQ and DQS — HIGH = host owns (write), LOW = device owns (read).

channels.name: WP_n
channels.description: Write Protect (active-low). When LOW, Program and Erase operations are disabled.

channels.name: R/B_n
channels.description: Ready/Busy (open-drain). LOW = at least one LUN operation in progress; requires external pull-up.

channels.name: DQ[7:0]
channels.description: 8-bit data bus. Carries opcode (during CLE), address byte (during ALE), or data (otherwise).

channels.name: DQ[15:8]
channels.description: Upper 8 bits of 16-bit data bus; only SDR x16 packages.

channels.name: DQS / DQS_t
channels.description: Data Strobe True (NV-DDR / NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3). Source-synchronous strobe; data latched on both edges.

channels.name: DQS_c
channels.description: Data Strobe Complement (optional NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 differential).

channels.name: VREFQ
channels.description: Input reference voltage (NV-DDR2 / NV-DDR3 single-ended path).

channels.name: ZQ
channels.description: ZQ calibration reference pin; tied to Vss via RZQ external resistor (typ. 300 Ω ±1%).

channels.name: ENi
channels.description: Enumeration input (CE_n pin reduction); daisy-chained from previous target's ENo.

channels.name: ENo
channels.description: Enumeration output (CE_n pin reduction); daisy-chained to next target's ENi.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: No per-byte VALID/READY on the wire — flow is regulated by host strobes (WE_n / RE_n / CLK / DQS) and the device R/B_n line.
R/B_n LOW is a busy indication; the host shall wait for R/B_n HIGH OR poll Status (70h) until RDY=1 before issuing a new command (except Read Status, Read Status Enhanced, Reset).
Multi-LUN: while R/B_n is LOW the host may poll a specific LUN via Read Status Enhanced (78h) with the LUN/plane row address.
Read Status Enhanced shall NOT be used during or after Target-level commands (e.g., Read Parameter Page, Read ID, ZQ Calibration); only Read Status (70h) applies in those sequences.

frame_format.command_cycle: CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising edge, DQ = opcode (8 bits).
frame_format.address_cycle: CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising edge, DQ = address byte (8 bits). Read / Program / Erase use 5 / 5 / 3 address cycles (2 column + 3 row, or 3 row only for Erase).
frame_format.write_data_cycle: CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n rising edge (SDR) or DQS edges (NV-DDR family), DQ = write byte.
frame_format.read_data_cycle: CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n falling edge (SDR) or RE_n_t/RE_n_c + DQS edges (NV-DDR family), DQ = device-driven read byte.
frame_format.status_byte: Single 8-bit value returned after 70h or 78h: {WP_n, RDY, ARDY, VSP, CSP, R, FAILC, FAIL}.
